Stack: Spring Boot 4, WebFlux, Kotlin Coroutines, jOOQ, R2DBC, PostgreSQL.

Use `*Router.kt` for `coRouter { }` routes/error handlers; `*Handler.kt` for suspended handlers delegating to services; `*Service.kt` for business logic, `<REDACTED_USER>` annotations, and `NotFoundException`; `*Repository.kt` for jOOQ DSL queries returning `Flow<T>` or `suspend` functions. Handlers use coroutines; repositories use `asFlow()`, `awaitFirst/awaitFirstOrNull`. Service-layer `<REDACTED_USER>` works via R2DBC connection factory proxy.

Make all external contracts openapi-generated in contract subproject resources; client/model classes share the contract owner’s base package. Model mapping uses extensions (e.g., `TestTable.toResponse()`).

Don't try to replace something by default values on errors. If you received something unexpected, log and rethrow IllegalArgumentException on incoming and IllegalStateException on outgoing
Never use optional Kotlin types for mandatory fields
Always prefer imports to fully qualified class names
Always remove unused imports and resources
All versions in `build.gradle.kts` should be variables from the root `build.gradle.kts`
When adding new dependencies, ensure they are up to date
Use jackson 3 for all components, avoid using jackson 2 when possible
IMPORTANT: After changing `build.gradle.kts`, always run `./gradlew clean nativeCompile test` on that subproject
IMPORTANT: After any changes, always run `./gradlew clean test` in a corresponding subproject
IMPORTANT: Always run `./gradlew clean test` on a root project after any changes in contract subproject
Consider fixing build or application-context startup warnings. Add comments when solutions aren’t obvious or multiple approaches need testing.

Each subproject needs its own database schema in subproject `gradle.properties`, `application.yml` (app and test), and `<REDACTED_USER>` annotation in `AbstractContextTest`. Migrations: `src/main/resources/db/migration/`; consider data migration. Run `./gradlew build` to regenerate jOOQ classes; use generated repository classes (e.g., `TEST_TABLE`, `TestTable` POJO). Don't use defaults in database schema; generate id/uuid/timestamp explicitly in code.

Never use optional Kotlin types for non-nullable fields. Please don't use nullability without a strong reason
Tests use Zonky embedded PostgreSQL and Flyway auto-migration. Context/database tests extend `AbstractContextTest` to avoid extra contexts/migrations. In spring context tests never use class-wide annotations on test classes
In spring context tests never use mocked beans in test classes to keep spring context clean
Instead of mocks in a spring context test, add spies to AbstractContextTest to keep spring context clean
For `AbstractContextTest` child tests use `<REDACTED_USER>` instead of inserts for initial state (if the test is not covering inserts) and `<REDACTED_USER>` for checks if the test is not covering reads
Separate repository/scenario dataset folders; each repository’s datasets get a separate folder. Test all layers.
Never use sleep in tests
`*HandlerTest`: WebTestClient HTTP tests; `*ServiceTest`: MockK unit tests; `*RepositoryTest`: embedded-database integration tests.
